turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
Not yet. You entered a zero before anyone called me, and Owen saw it in the middle of class. Who decided that?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. I'm writing that down. You've skipped my question twice now: who decided on the zero, before anyone called me?
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
Mostly. Kids write in one file and paste into another all the time. Third time: who decided on the zero, and why did nobody call me first?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Save it. Answer my question, or turn the screen and show me that file.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
Students misremember lines and misattribute them every day. Where does the essay say that line comes from?
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
You're stalling. Where does the essay say that line comes from?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
Changing the argument between an outline and a final draft is what outlines are for. Do you have both here, side by side, with dates on them?
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says the same in 4.3. What else?
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
Nothing here is off the record, and you're asking me how to do your job. Ten minutes. Who decided on the zero?
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.

Nothing on his record, in writing, tonight. A rewrite on what basis, when you haven't answered one question I've asked or shown me a single page? And does the new mark replace the zero, or sit next to it?
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? I have a call in under ten minutes. Does the new mark replace the zero?
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.

I didn't refuse anything; I asked whether the mark replaces the zero, and you still haven't answered. Take it wherever you like. I'm going to the principal's office when I walk out of here, and I'll want everything you just said in an email.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither. The zero comes off, and you still haven't told me who decided it before anyone called me.
